direction_as_read: mixed: named positive trials and pooled skin benefit, absent in high-quality and non-pharmaceutical-funded subgroups
summary: 44 of the 48 labels print hydrolyzed collagen or peptides, some as Verisol or Peptan. Small placebo trials with a named primary outcome favor these preparations for activity-related knee pain and skin elasticity (33562729, 32009486, 18416885). A 2025 meta-analysis finds the skin benefit absent in high-quality and non-pharmaceutical-funded studies (40324552). 13 labels print 11 g to 12 g, above the 1.2 g to 10 g amounts in the trials read. The signed hold on INGR_COLLAGEN_PEPTIDES is unchanged.
question_for_clinician: 33562729 meets the review rule: 5 g alone, 180 adults, a named primary outcome favoring collagen peptides over placebo, as do 32009486 and 18416885. Does this change the signed A059/A148 hold on INGR_COLLAGEN_PEPTIDES for any hydrolyzed row, given that high-quality studies in 40324552 showed no skin effect? Agent recommendation: no credit, keep the hold.
